newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 8.105 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 8.105 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for 91-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.105 percent versus 8.263 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
Bids for the $75 million offer totalled only $40 million.

Bids for a $75 million offer of 189-day Treasury bills were over-accepted to compensate. The weighted average yield for NZ$110 million accepted was 7.794 percent versus 8.030 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 406-day treasury bills was 6.713 percent versus 7.863 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$100 million of 48-day seasonal treasury bills was 8.19 pct, compared with 7.41 percent at the last auction of 44-day paper on July 8. Bids totalled NZ$150 million.
